# Frozen V1 typed-record fixture

`v1-minimal.occts` is a checked-in binary literal, not regenerated by tests.
SHA-256: `2704bb6b11faa5eb241df30e1de987794b0fe78a0064f6bcb66be10dfa1c8771`.

It was captured once on 2026-10-22 with the first typed-storage implementation,
acadrust 0.6.4, based on upstream b735054e1fa5736f2a410f07a372985c6277c23f.
Transport dependencies resolved to rmp-serde 1.3.1 / rmp 0.8.15 /
serde_ignored 0.1.14. Input was `CadDocument::new()` with these explicit changes:

- namespace `v1-minimal`;
- summary title `Frozen V1 typed fixture`;
- header create_ellipse_as_polyline true;
- one line from (1,2,3) to (7,8,9), common.material_flags 3;
- one class `FROZEN_CLASS` / `FrozenClass` with class_number 777, appended with
  `push_preserving`.

The checked bytes begin `4f 43 43 54 53 4e 41 50 00 00 00 01`, followed by a
five-field named MessagePack envelope. Its kind is `typed-records`, codec version
`0.6.4`, and body is binary containing the named record map. Defaults emitted by
the constructor are literal fixture values, not a requirement for future writers
to reproduce constructor metadata or exact bytes.

`typed_storage_literal.rs` pins independent semantic expectations for those
authored values, without calling capture or the writer to construct its input.
A separate malformed-input helper removes the eleven common Serde fields and
tests their declared defaults. Spline/associative missing-field defaults are
covered by `typed_storage_serde.rs` and its older named JSON fixture.
This fixture covers typed storage reading, not document restore or CAD export.
